list.name: cian sentences
list.word: I saw the magician do a trick.
The electrician will repair the wiring.
The musician played me a song.
That optician will help my eyesight.
The technician will fix my computer.
The beautician gave me a facial treatment.
The sick boy went to a physician.
The funeral was led by the mortician.
A dietician will help me lose weight.
